name: PremiumShot for Chrome
whats_new: Large captures now move to the editor as local PNG blobs, removing the previous 8 MB transfer limit. Capture, styling and export remain on your device.
short_description: Capture a visible tab or select a webpage component, choose a look, and copy a polished image. Processed locally.
suggested_category: Tools / Productivity (confirm the available dashboard label)
item_strategy: One item; retain its identity when the beta becomes public.
single_purpose: Capture or import a screenshot, compose it locally with a PremiumShot background and adjustable spacing, corners and shadow, then copy or download the finished PNG.
urls_status: Planned only: domain not purchased or deployed as of 2026-10-10.
